title: Parampara
desc: When a gang of criminals kidnaps Johnny's son, he is left with no choice but to work with Lawrence, his estranged father, to save him.

title: British Market
desc: Kunjamma and her sons run a business and lead a successful life. When Chennaikara, a thug, threatens them, her eldest son is determined to fight against him.

title: Koushalam
desc: Gopinadhan and Mathunni steal money from the rich and distribute it amongst the needy. When Mathunni robs Maya, Gopinadhan returns it and falls in love with her.

desc: Bhaskaran, a goldsmith, is madly in love with Snehalatha, the daughter of the astrologer, Panicker. When he asks for her hand in marriage, to his shock, she denies their love affair.

title: Varnappakittu
